UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Accessibility, language, notification, and opt-in history preferences for a signed-in CheckFirst user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID matching the parent document path.

tamil.description: Whether the Tamil interface language is active.

simpleMode.description: Whether Simple Mode with larger targets and concise guidance is enabled.

largeText.description: Whether enlarged accessible text scaling is enabled.

safetyTips.description: Whether in-app educational safety reminders are enabled.

completionAlerts.description: Whether scan completion notice banners are enabled.

saveHistory.description: Opt-in toggle for saving metadata-only check history (off by default).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

CheckHistoryEntry.title: CheckHistoryEntry
CheckHistoryEntry.description: Opt-in metadata-only record of a financial safety check. Never stores raw messages, QR payloads, UPI IDs, PINs, or OTPs.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID matching the parent document path.

kind.description: Category of check performed (e.g., Message scan, UPI link analysis, Loan cost calculation, Loan risk check).

label.description: Generic privacy-safe summary label without user-entered sensitive data.

risk.description: Assessment tier produced by the check.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Owner-isolated user accessibility and privacy preferences (document ID: default).

/users/{userId}/checkHistory/{entryId}.description: Owner-isolated opt-in metadata-only check history entries.
